name: Rosewood Mansion On Turtle Creek
positioning: Rosewood Mansion on Turtle Creek: a hotel built around a historic 1925 estate in Dallas's Turtle Creek neighborhood, with residential-style rooms and a well-known restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a historic estate setting in Dallas
Food lovers who plan to dine at the hotel's restaurant, bar and afternoon tea

facts.text: The Mansion Bar sits in the heart of the historic 1925 estate.
The Mansion Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine with French flair, made from fresh, local ingredients.
The Mansion Restaurant has a smart casual dress code.
The Mansion Bar's seasonal rotating menu uses local ingredients.
The Mansion has private dining rooms with a residential style.
Rooms and suites have garden views and residentially-inspired details.
The Mansion Pool offers poolside service.
The hotel is in the Turtle Creek neighborhood.
Afternoon tea brings heirloom organic teas, savory sandwiches, signature scones and pastries.
The Restaurant Terrace offers al fresco dining with seasonal cuisine in garden surroundings.

highlights.text: Heritage Afternoon Tea is served in the 1925 Mansion Library, a setting inspired by the 16th-century Italian Renaissance.
The Mansion Restaurant's tortilla soup has stayed on the menu through chef changes and concept shifts.
The pool is temperature-controlled, open year-round and reserved for hotel guests only.
Guests can book the Signature STURMGLOW facial, created exclusively by Dr. Barbara Sturm.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Katy Trail.

considerations.text: Terrace service is subject to weather conditions.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited recreational facilities compared with resort-style properties.
